pages.quiz:
MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #1
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. 2/2
   B. They are equal
   C. 1/4
   D. Cannot tell

2. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 42
   C. 21
   D. 90

3. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x + 2
   B. 6x + 2
   C. 12x
   D. 6x

4. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.6
   B. 29
   C. 23
   D. 23.7

5. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 19.7
   C. 19.6
   D. 19

6. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 25
   C. 1
   D. 1

7. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 66
   B. 22
   C. 34
   D. 17

8. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 12 cm³
   B. 9 cm³
   C. 27 cm³
   D. 18 cm³

9. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 43
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 2

10. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.6
   B. 15.7
   C. 21
   D. 15

11. What is √100? (1 mark)
   A. 100
   B. 11
   C. 10
   D. 50

12. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.6
   B. 37
   C. 31
   D. 31.7

13. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 1000 m²
   B. 100 000 m²
   C. 10 000 m²
   D. 100 m²

14. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.205
   B. 0.025
   C. 0.25
   D. 2.5

15. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 3/4
   B. 2/3
   C. 1/2
   D. 1/4

16. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 2

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
